description: Copy an existing website (a WordPress site, a static site, or the Wayback Machine's saved copy of one) into a Hostlo site: its pages, styles, scripts, images and fonts, with links rewritten to work on Hostlo. Only import a site the person owns or has the right to copy, and ask them if that is not clear. A small site finishes in the reply; a big one carries on in the background and import_status reports on it. Afterwards tell them what the reply says could not be carried over (forms, logins, search, shop checkouts need the old server).

from_archive.description:
Copy the newest version the Wayback Machine saved instead of the live site: for a site whose
hosting has expired. Default false.

site.description:
The Hostlo site to import into (create it first with create_site). Imported files are added to
it, replacing files with the same path; list_deploys and rollback undo the import.

url.description:
The address of the site to copy, for example "example.com" or "https://www.example.com/", or a
Wayback Machine link (web.archive.org/web/...).

name: import_site
